units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 93b:12">B. Kam. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>דסָרְקֵיה סָרוּקֵי</he> he carded the wool with a comb, opp. <he>נפציה נפוצי</he> hatchelled it by beating.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:8">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>, end <he>ס׳ שעריה</he> he combs his hair.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 10b:2">M. Kat. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>לסָרוּקֵי סוסיא</he> to curry a horse.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 57b">Gitt. 57ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מְסָרֵיקִנָא וכ׳</he> I shall flay your flesh with iron combs; Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) <he>סְרֵיקְנָא</he>; a. e.
